hypothesis: Unconditional Backspace retirement loses the already confirmed Reset predecessor whose observed word range exceeds the reset lineage. Preserve only inert shortened provenance across one native deletion, then require a fresh exact client receipt for authority.
chosen_route: Use existing PendingContextResetRereceipt, existing reducer settlement and snapshot verifier. Start with an actual legacy callback regression that fails on current source. Bound rebind to an already confirmed owner-matched exact old client receipt, end-caret/no selection, exact one-scalar mirror deletion and one epoch advance, unchanged owner/focus/layout/lineage identity. New state is unconfirmed, has no published stale preedit and no text edit authority. Fresh actual Reset and exact surrounding receipt must prove shortened token before completion acceptance; retire on drift/mismatch/no receipt.
constraints: Native Backspace remains handled=false and causes exactly one client deletion; no duplicate CommitText/DeleteSurroundingText or physical replay.
Hide preedit before handing Backspace to client, and do not republish a hint during that Backspace callback. Preserve the existing WeChat contract.
Use no application-name, word, suffix or fixture-specific runtime condition.
No generic unknown-start promotion, no removal of snapshot/owner checks, no SafetyGate weakening.
A wholly erased word does not carry prior provenance; exact empty client boundary must establish the next word through existing mechanisms.
No new owner, detector, executor, layout operation, cache, timer, polling, callback or fallback.
alternatives: Reconstruct arbitrary unknown word authority directly from later text rejected because it loses the original owner/input/epoch provenance.
Keep the old receipt confirmed after client Backspace rejected because the client may delete a selection, move its caret, or reject the edit.
Native single-deletion inert rebind selected because it reuses the existing causal receipt and independently verifies the actual client result.

consequences.candidates_and_rank: No candidate removal, ranking, Keep or edit-decision change; fresh prefix gets existing candidates only after current-state evidence.
consequences.false_authority: Primary risk is treating a mirror as applied client text. New pending state must be unconfirmed and have no stale publication; exact current client receipt is mandatory before Tab.
consequences.latency_and_resources: No new waits or workers; bounded existing word/receipt cloning only, no corpus scan, package growth or persistent memory. Verify no duplicate background scheduling/publication in Backspace.
consequences.cache_packages_learning: Existing generation invalidation and completion clearing remain; no model/package/reload/cache source identity change and no learning from unconfirmed deletion.
consequences.concurrency: Reset may arrive after the key or before its settlement; actual production observer/callback ordering must be tested. Owner/focus/layout/epoch/selection drift must revoke.
consequences.compatibility: Preserve managed owned-preedit C06, terminal native route, single text executor and native Backspace release; generic negative tests remain strict.
consequences.failure_rollback: Refuse stale/missing/mismatched client confirmation. Only root may install a proved IME, with exact C03 rollback and unchanged daemon/global IBus/model bytes.
consequences.maintenance: Extend existing receipt transfer, no second controller. Remove nothing by weakening; future source changes must retain causal negative guards.
